body:
Parser implements GRAMMAR.md §2's covered EBNF subset. Emitter calls PARENA/stdlib/base4/algebra.prn. Real CLI (lo build). Found and honestly documented a real prefix-vs-infix notation discrepancy between examples/xor_check.llll and GRAMMAR.md/source spec -- kept parser matching the reviewed canonical grammar. Verified end-to-end: lo build's .prn output fed through real parena build -> cc -> execution, correct exit code (1 XOR 3 = 2). burrow build honestly skipped (real, separate limitation: no cross-module import resolution). Found and documented that naming a defn 'main' produces a real runnable C entry point by coincidence, not design. go build/vet/test clean. LO commit e07ca40.

⚓ ☃
title: Phase 1 complete: real LO compiler (lexer→parser→emitter→CLI), verified end-to-end
